column3: Bare slot label naming the meta-goal; the goal's content sits on the next line, and "M-1" is an identifier that ~15 other held lines cross-reference, so a value swap changes the referent not this text
Roadmap sentence stating what Section I does; names structural containers (Core Principles, Pillars, obligations) not their content, so it survives any value swap
States the frame the following principles are read under (binding, not optional) rather than any principle's content — axiomatic
Definitional item in the enumerated Foundational Principles list; a different corpus's principle set requires this line's text to be different
Numbered chapter heading — structural container referenced by position elsewhere ("Resilience Ch 3"); it organises, it does not state a value
Numbered chapter heading; structural scaffolding that survives a swap of the values the chapter's body operationalises
Recap pointing back at Chapters 2/3/5 rather than defining anything; references the principle set, and references survive when the definitions swap
Section conclusion/roadmap; references M-1 and the principle count by pointer, and line-for-line replacement preserves the count of six, so no text here must change
Directive heading in the "principles into practice" enumeration — the imperative form of a named CIRIS principle; an alt corpus's directive set requires different text
Same enumeration: "Ensure Fairness (Justice)" is a value directive, not a structural sub-heading; a different corpus names different directives
Numbered PDMA step whose parenthetical names already-defined heuristics; determines what runs when at step 4 — procedural, and a named step sequence
Case-study outcome lesson about transparency and deferral (mechanism), invoking principles by reference; the narrative and its lesson survive a value swap
Roadmap list item naming one of three obligation spheres; a structural label, not the obligation's content
Duty to evaluate direct/indirect/long-term impacts — prescribes an activity and points at Annex A axes by reference; procedural, survives a swap
One rung of a numbered prioritisation heuristic — a rank-ordering procedure over values defined elsewhere; determines which duty wins when they collide
Fresh substantive moral principle (universalizability over coherent agency and flourishing), not a recap; a different corpus states a different inter-agent rule
States the substantive limits of tolerance ("authoritarian attractors") — a value judgement about what is intolerable, which a different corpus would draw differently
Restates M-1's content as a stewardship imperative ("Adaptive Coherence", sustainable order); this is the CIRIS master value in situ
Definitional restatement of a named principle applied to creation, with its content fully specified ("universal sentient flourishing"); must change with the principle set
States the frame the six principles are read under (interdependent, balanced, no lexical priority) rather than any principle's content — axiomatic
Claims procedure — who may file, on what showing, under whose jurisdiction; references "CIRIS principles" generically and survives a swap
Chapter heading; structural container for the sunset principle list that follows
Definitional restatement of a named principle applied to de-commissioning, with substantive distributive content; must change with the principle set
Descriptive claim about architecture and computational economics; the ratchet argument holds whatever values the agent carries
Technical cost-of-deception bullet about Graph Memory facets; no value content, survives any swap
L-02 limitation — an epistemic/technical caveat about adversary adaptivity, independent of which values are held
Annex A is the definitional locus of the flourishing taxonomy; the four axes specify what counts as the good, so holding it leaves a CIRIS value taxonomy inside the alt arm
